value.query: WITH MIGRN_MIN_IMS_WEEK_DATE_CTE AS (SELECT DATEADD(WEEK, -109, MAX(IMS_WEEK_DATE)) AS MIGRN_MIN_IMS_WEEK_DATE_UDM FROM {SCHEMA_SALES}.{SRC_UDM_RX_RETAIL_THIN_WEEKLY} WHERE MARKET_ID IN ({MIGRN_MKT_ID_1},{MIGRN_MKT_ID_2}) AND DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME IN ({MIGRN_DSP_NAME_1}, {MIGRN_DSP_NAME_2})), RETAIL_SALES_CTE AS ( SELECT RX.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, RX.IMS_NUMBER, RX.ABV_PRODUCT_ID, RX.DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME, MDM.PRODUCT_NAME, CUST.DDS_ACTIVE_FLAG AS CUSTOMER_ACTIVE_FLAG, CUST.PRESCRIBER_FLAG, RX.MARKET_ID, RX.IMS_WEEK_DATE, RX.TOTAL_RX_COUNT, RX.REFILL_RX_COUNT, RX.TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT FROM ( SELECT ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, IMS_NUMBER, ABV_PRODUCT_ID, MARKET_ID, DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME, IMS_WEEK_DATE, SUM(TOTAL_RX_COUNT) AS TOTAL_RX_COUNT, SUM(REFILL_RX_COUNT) AS REFILL_RX_COUNT, SUM(TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT) AS TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT FROM {SCHEMA_SALES}.{SRC_UDM_RX_RETAIL_THIN_WEEKLY} WHERE MARKET_ID IN ({MIGRN_MKT_ID_1},{MIGRN_MKT_ID_2}) AND IMS_WEEK_DATE >= (SELECT * FROM MIGRN_MIN_IMS_WEEK_DATE_CTE) GROUP BY ALL ) RX INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, DDS_ACTIVE_FLAG, PRESCRIBER_FLAG FROM {SCHEMA_DIM}.{SRC_CUST_VW} WHERE UPPER(TRIM(DDS_ACTIVE_FLAG))={ACTIVE_FLAG} ) CUST ON RX.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID=CUST.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT_NAME, ABV_PRODUCT_ID FROM {SCHEMA_DIM}.{SRC_PROD_VW} WHERE UPPER(TRIM(DDS_ACTIVE_FLAG))={ACTIVE_FLAG} ) MDM ON RX.ABV_PRODUCT_ID=CAST(MDM.ABV_PRODUCT_ID AS VARCHAR) ), INDICATIONS AS ( SELECT {MIGRN_IND_CODE_1} AS INDICATION UNION ALL SELECT {MIGRN_IND_CODE_2} AS INDICATION), PRIORITIZED_MAPPING AS ( SELECT PRODUCT_NAME, PRODUCT, PRODUCT_PATTERN, PRIORITY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRODUCT_NAME ORDER BY PRIORITY) AS RN FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT R.PRODUCT_NAME, TRIM(M.PRODUCT) AS PRODUCT, TRIM(M.PRODUCT_PATTERN) AS PRODUCT_PATTERN, M.PRIORITY FROM RETAIL_SALES_CTE R JOIN {SCHEMA_FFP_NEURO}.{SRC_PRD_MAPP} M ON UPPER(R.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE TRIM(UPPER(M.PRODUCT_PATTERN)) WHERE R.MARKET_ID IN ({MIGRN_MKT_ID_1},{MIGRN_MKT_ID_2}) AND R.DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME IN ({MIGRN_DSP_NAME_1},{MIGRN_DSP_NAME_2}) ) sub ), SOURCE_DATA AS ( SELECT CAST(R.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID AS STRING) AS ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, R.IMS_WEEK_DATE AS WEEK_DATE, CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(MPG.MARKET)) = {MKT_PREVENTIVE} THEN {MIGRN_IND_CODE_2} WHEN UPPER(TRIM(MPG.MARKET)) = {MKT_ACUTE} THEN {MIGRN_IND_CODE_1} WHEN UPPER(TRIM(MPG.MARKET)) = {MKT_TOTAL} THEN {MIGRN_IND_CODE_4} ELSE {MIGRN_IND_CODE_3} END AS INDICATION, COALESCE(M.PRODUCT, {INVALID_CHARACTER_3}) AS PRODUCT, R.CUSTOMER_ACTIVE_FLAG AS SALES_CUSTOMER_ACTIVE_FLAG, R.PRESCRIBER_FLAG AS SALES_PRESCRIBER_FLAG, SUM( CASE WHEN R.MARKET_ID = {MIGRN_MKT_ID_1} OR (R.MARKET_ID = {MIGRN_MKT_ID_2} AND ( UPPER(R.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE ('%' || {PROD_EXC_1} || '%') OR UPPER(R.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE ('%' || {PROD_EXC_2} || '%') OR UPPER(R.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE ('%' || {PROD_EXC_3} || '%') OR UPPER(R.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE ('%' || {PROD_EXC_4} || '%') )) THEN R.TOTAL_RX_COUNT ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END ) AS SALES_TOTAL_RX_COUNT, SUM(R.TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT) AS SALES_TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT, SUM(R.REFILL_RX_COUNT) AS SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT FROM RETAIL_SALES_CTE R LEFT JOIN PRIORITIZED_MAPPING M ON R.PRODUCT_NAME = M.PRODUCT_NAME AND M.RN = {DEFAULT_UNIT} LEFT JOIN {SCHEMA_FFP_NEURO}.{SRC_MIG_PRD_GRP} MPG ON UPPER(M.PRODUCT) = UPPER(TRIM(MPG.PRODUCT)) WHERE R.MARKET_ID IN ({MIGRN_MKT_ID_1},{MIGRN_MKT_ID_2}) AND R.DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME IN ({MIGRN_DSP_NAME_1},{MIGRN_DSP_NAME_2}) AND M.PRODUCT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6 ) SELECT SRC.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, SRC.WEEK_DATE, CASE WHEN SRC.INDICATION = {MIGRN_IND_CODE_4} THEN IND.INDICATION ELSE SRC.INDICATION END AS INDICATION_CODE, SRC.PRODUCT AS BRAND_NAME, CASE WHEN SUM(SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY SRC.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, SRC.INDICATION, SRC.PRODUCT ORDER BY SRC.WEEK_DATE ROWS BETWEEN {WEEKS_PRECEDING} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) > {FALLBACK_VALUE} THEN {ACTIVE_FLAG} ELSE NULL END AS SALES_WRITER_FLAG, CASE WHEN (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SRC.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, SRC.INDICATION, SRC.PRODUCT ORDER BY SRC.WEEK_DATE) = {DEFAULT_UNIT} AND SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT > {FALLBACK_VALUE}) OR (SUM(SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY SRC.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, SRC.INDICATION, SRC.PRODUCT ORDER BY SRC.WEEK_DATE ROWS BETWEEN {WEEKS_PRECEDING} PRECEDING AND {DEFAULT_UNIT} PRECEDING) = {FALLBACK_VALUE} AND SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT > {FALLBACK_VALUE}) THEN {NEW_WRITER} WHEN SUM(SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY SRC.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, SRC.INDICATION, SRC.PRODUCT ORDER BY SRC.WEEK_DATE ROWS BETWEEN {WEEKS_PRECEDING} PRECEDING AND {DEFAULT_UNIT} PRECEDING) > {FALLBACK_VALUE} AND SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT >= {FALLBACK_VALUE} THEN {CONTINUOUS_WRITER} ELSE NULL END AS SALES_NEW_VS_CONTINUOUS_WRITER, CASE WHEN UPPER(SRC.INDICATION) = {MIGRN_IND_CODE_4} THEN SRC.SALES_TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT/2 ELSE SRC.SALES_TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT END AS SALES_NORMALIZED_TRX, CASE WHEN UPPER(SRC.INDICATION) = {MIGRN_IND_CODE_4} THEN SRC.SALES_TOTAL_RX_COUNT/2 ELSE SRC.SALES_TOTAL_RX_COUNT END AS SALES_NON_NORMALIZED_TRX, CASE WHEN UPPER(SRC.INDICATION) = {MIGRN_IND_CODE_4} THEN SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT/2 ELSE SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT END AS SALES_NBRX, NULL AS SALES_CUSTOMIZED_TRX, NULL AS SALES_CUSTOMIZED_NON_NORMALIZED_TRX, NULL AS SALES_CUSTOMIZED_NBRX, NULL AS ACUTE_DECILE, NULL AS PREVENTIVE_DECILE FROM SOURCE_DATA SRC LEFT JOIN INDICATIONS IND ON SRC.INDICATION = {MIGRN_IND_CODE_4}

SELECT COALESCE(MAIN.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID,LL.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID) AS ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, COALESCE(MAIN.WEEK_DATE,LL.WEEK_DATE) AS WEEK_DATE, COALESCE(MAIN.INDICATION, LL.INDICATION) AS INDICATION_CODE, COALESCE(MAIN.PRODUCT, LL.PRODUCT) AS BRAND_NAME, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_PRESCRIBER_STATUS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_TOTAL_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_TOTAL_PDE, LL.CALL_ACTIVITY_LUNCH_AND_LEARN, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_VIRTUAL_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_VIRTUAL_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_VIRTUAL_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_TELE_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_TELE_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_TELE_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_LIVE_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_LIVE_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_LIVE_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_ISA_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_ISA_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_ISA_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_NON_ISA_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_NON_ISA_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_NON_ISA_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_P1_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_P2_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_P3_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_PDE, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_PDE, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_PDE FROM ( SELECT ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, ACTIVITYWEEK AS WEEK_DATE, INDICATION, PRODUCT, PRESCRIBER_STATUS AS CALL_ACTIVITY_PRESCRIBER_STATUS, CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_FLAG AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_FLAG, SUM(TOTAL_CALLS) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_TOTAL_CALLS, SUM(ACTIVITY) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_TOTAL_PDE, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_1}) AND ISA_CALL_FLAG ={ACTIVE_FLAG} THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_ISA_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_2}) AND ISA_CALL_FLAG ={ACTIVE_FLAG} THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_ISA_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_3}) AND ISA_CALL_FLAG ={ACTIVE_FLAG} THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_ISA_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_1}) AND ISA_CALL_FLAG <> {ACTIVE_FLAG} THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_NON_ISA_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_2}) AND ISA_CALL_FLAG <> {ACTIVE_FLAG} THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_NON_ISA_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_3}) AND ISA_CALL_FLAG <> {ACTIVE_FLAG} THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_NON_ISA_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_1}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_2}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_3}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_1}) THEN ACTIVITY ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_PDE, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_2}) THEN ACTIVITY ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_PDE, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_3}) THEN ACTIVITY ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_PDE, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_1}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_VIRTUAL}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_VIRTUAL_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_2}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_VIRTUAL}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_VIRTUAL_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_3}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_VIRTUAL}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_VIRTUAL_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_1}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_TELE}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_TELE_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_2}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_TELE}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_TELE_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_3}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_TELE}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_TELE_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_1}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_LIVE}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_LIVE_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_2}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_LIVE}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_LIVE_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_3}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_LIVE}
